data.description:
## Description

**What**: Comparison script run at epic close. Per-fixture grounded-finding counts shift from zero (pre-loop baseline from c6de Story 1) to non-zero (post-loop) on >=60% of fixtures. Quality-not-just-presence: on a curated subset (>=5 fixtures) where local /dso:review findings are known, post-change CI findings overlap with local on >=N critical/important items per fixture, OR speculation-marker frequency in CI finding text decreases by >=25% relative to baseline.

**Why**: SC5. Without quality assertion, a reviewer emitting one trivial file:line per fixture would pass the presence-only metric.

**Scope**:
- IN: comparison script; curated fixture subset selection criteria; speculation-marker frequency calculator; close-artifact reporting
- OUT: ongoing in-CI delta tracking (one-shot at close)

## Done Definitions

- When complete, the comparison script runs at epic close and reports per-fixture grounded-finding shift on the full corpus ← Satisfies: SC5 (presence)
- When complete, the curated subset assertion confirms either overlap >=N items with local /dso:review OR speculation-marker reduction >=25% ← Satisfies: SC5 (quality)

## Considerations

- [Testing] Curated subset must be small enough to maintain (>=5, <=15 fixtures) but representative of the failure modes the loop targets

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, the before/after fixture-corpus delta validates grounded-finding presence and quality
